title: Haritaki (Terminalia chebula Retz.) - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for Haritaki fruit used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines, including foreign matter, loss on drying, ash values and extractive values.

title: Ashvagandha (Withania somnifera L. Dunal) - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for Ashvagandha root used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines, including total ash, acid-insoluble ash and withanolide extractive content.

title: Haridra (Curcuma longa L.) - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for Haridra (turmeric) rhizome used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines and dietary supplements.

title: Amalaki (Phyllanthus emblica L.) Dried Fruit - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for dried Amalaki fruit used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines and rasayanas.

title: Guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia) Stem - Specification
scope: Specifies quality and identity criteria for Guduchi stem used in immunomodulatory and antipyretic formulations.

title: Service Requirements for Yoga Centers
scope: Specifies requirements for service provision at Yoga Centers including infrastructure, trainer competency, hygiene, emergency care, and traditional adherence.

title: Cotton Yoga Mats - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for woven and non-woven cotton yoga mats for non-slip, sweat-absorbent, eco-friendly physical yoga practice.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
scope: Specifies physical, chemical, and microbiological requirements and methods of test for packaged drinking water offered for sale in sealed containers. Mandatory ISI certification under Food Safety & BIS regulations.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for natural mineral water collected directly from natural or drilled underground sources.

title: Drinking Water Specification (Piped & Municipal Supply)
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for drinking water intended for human consumption across municipal piped supplies.

title: Milk Powder - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for whole milk powder, partly skimmed milk powder and skimmed milk powder.

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements (Laptops, Adapters, Chargers)
scope: Applicable to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including computer power adapters, laptops, printers, scanners and display units under MEITY Compulsory Registration Scheme.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes (Lithium-ion Batteries)
scope: Requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable secondary lithium cells and batteries used in smartphones, laptops, power banks, and tablets.

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements (Smart TVs, Soundbars)
scope: Applies to electronic apparatus designed to be fed from mains, supply apparatus, batteries or remote feed, intended for reception, generation or recording of audio/video.

title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements - Fixed General Purpose Luminaires (LED Tube Lights & Panels)
scope: Specifies safety and constructional requirements for fixed general purpose luminaires using LED modules, for supply voltages not exceeding 1000 V.

title: Lamp Controlgear - Particular Requirements for DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scope: Covers electronic controlgear (LED drivers) for use on d.c. supplies up to 250 V and a.c. supplies up to 1000 V at 50 Hz or 60 Hz.

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements regarding material, construction, workmanship, finish and performance for protective helmets for everyday motorcycle and two-wheeler riders. Mandatory ISI certification under MoRTH notification.

title: Electric Vehicle Conductive Charging System - General Requirements (EV Chargers & Wallboxes)
scope: Applies to on-board and off-board equipment for charging electric road vehicles at standard a.c. supply voltages up to 1000 V and at d.c. voltages up to 1500 V.

title: Plugs, Socket-Outlets, Vehicle Connectors and Vehicle Inlets - Conductive Charging of Electric Vehicles
scope: Specifies dimensional interchangeability, safety pins, mechanical strength, and environmental testing for EV charging connectors and plugs.

title: Lead-Acid Starter Batteries for Motor Vehicles - Specification
scope: Applies to lead-acid batteries with a nominal voltage of 12 V, used primarily as a power source for the starting and ignition of internal combustion engines.

title: Safety Glass - Specification - Part 2: For Road Transport Vehicles (Toughened & Laminated Windshields)
scope: Requirements for toughened safety glass and laminated safety glass windshields and windows intended for automotive vehicles.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification - Part 1: Fly Ash Based (PPC)
scope: Covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements of fly ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement for structural concrete, plastering, and masonry.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC 33, 43, 53 Grade) - Specification
scope: Covers manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of 33, 43 and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (TMT Rebars)
scope: Covers requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
scope: Covers requirements for structural steel plates, shapes, sections, and flats for bridges, high-rise buildings, and heavy engineering.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Mechanical and Physical Properties
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of test for toys intended for use by children in various age groups from birth to 14 years. Focuses on small parts, sharp edges, and choking hazards.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 2: Flammability Requirements
scope: Specifies categories of flammable materials prohibited in all toys and requirements concerning flammability of certain toys when subjected to a small flame source.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements (Toxic Heavy Metals)
scope: Prescribes maximum acceptable levels and methods of sampling and extraction prior to analysis for migration of heavy metal elements from toy materials.

title: Safety of Electric Toys - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for the safety of toys that have at least one function dependent on electricity, supply voltages up to 24 V.

title: Medical Face Masks - Specification (3-Ply Surgical Masks)
scope: Specifies construction, design, performance requirements and test methods for medical face masks intended to limit transmission of infective agents.

title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Filtering Half Masks to Protect Against Particles (N95 / FFP2)
scope: Specifies requirements for filtering half masks used as respiratory protective devices against particulates.

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Safety Footwear (Steel Toe Industrial Shoes)
scope: Specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear incorporating safety toecaps designed to provide protection against impact.

title: Sports Footwear - Specification - Part 1: General Purpose
scope: Specifies requirements and testing methods for athletic and sports footwear under the Quality Control Order for Footwear.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
scope: Lays down requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules for long-term operation in open-air climates.

title: Safety of Power Converters for Use in Photovoltaic Power Systems - Particular Requirements for Inverters
scope: Addresses the specific safety requirements for inverters designed to connect to utility grids and off-grid solar energy systems.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking (Gold Hallmarking)
scope: Prescribes requirements for fineness, alloy composition, and hallmarking of gold jewellery, bullion, and artefacts. Mandates HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification).

title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking
scope: Prescribes requirements for fineness and hallmarking of silver jewellery and artefacts in purity grades 990, 925 (Sterling), 900, 835, and 800.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V (House Wiring)
scope: Covers the requirements of single-core and multi-core cables with copper or aluminium conductors, PVC insulated and sheathed for domestic and industrial installation.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases (Domestic LPG Cylinders)
scope: Specifies manufacturing, welding, hydrostatic testing, and bursting pressure requirements for 14.2 kg and 19 kg welded steel LPG cylinders.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Electric Irons
scope: Safety of electric dry irons and steam irons for household and similar use, rated voltage not exceeding 250 V.

title: Line Operated Three-Phase Energy Efficient Induction Motors (IE2, IE3, IE4 Efficiency Classes)
scope: Specifies energy efficiency classes and test procedures for low voltage three-phase cage induction motors according to national energy conservation targets.

title: Precast Concrete Blocks for Paving - Specification
scope: Covers requirements for precast concrete interlocking paving blocks for pedestrian walkaways, industrial yards, and highway pavements.
